title: Rename Plot ID prefix from pl- to plot- to avoid collision with seeds plan IDs
description:
## Problem

Plot IDs (`pl-<8 lowercase alnum>`, SPEC §3.3) collide with seeds plan IDs (`pl-<4 hex>`, 8-hex fallback) on the prefix. Both can appear in the same agent context — warren integrates both as opt-in features (warren SPEC §11.O, CLAUDE.md). Concrete evidence: this very repo has `.seeds/issues.jsonl` with `plot-95ed` issues referencing `pl-f853` plan IDs sitting next to `.plot/pl-5995e885.json`. Three ID types, two with `pl-` prefix.

The seeds 8-hex fallback can even produce a string that is syntactically a valid Plot ID.

## Decision

Rename Plot prefix `pl-` → `plot-`. Format becomes `plot-<8 lowercase alphanumeric>` (e.g. `plot-abc12345`). Rationale:

- Self-documenting in env vars (`PLOT_ID=plot-abc12345`) and logs
- Plot's own seeds project prefix is already `plot-` — consistent
- Plot is v0.1.1 with one Plot in existence, vs seeds v0.4.0 with widespread plan ID references across the ecosystem (mulch records, commits, CLAUDE.md docs). Renaming plot is the smaller blast radius.
- `pt-` was considered and rejected as cryptic; IDs aren't hand-typed often, the extra chars are cheap.

## Migration surface (in plot)

- `src/id.ts` — `PLOT_ID_RE`, `assertPlotId` message, `generatePlotId`
- `src/io.ts` — `PLOT_JSON_RE` filename regex
- `src/cli/commands/doctor.ts` — `^pl-...events.jsonl$` regex
- `src/schemas.ts` — `PLOT_ID_PATTERN`
- `src/types.ts` — `id: string; // pl-xxxxxxxx` comment
- `SPEC.md` §3.3, filename examples in §3.1/§3.2/§4, §5 etc.
- README.md, CHANGELOG.md
- All test fixtures (`pl-test0001`, `pl-deadbeef`, `pl-abc12345`, etc.)
- One existing Plot file pair to rename: `.plot/pl-5995e885.{json,events.jsonl}` → `.plot/plot-5995e885.{json,events.jsonl}`. The Plot's `id` field inside the JSON also needs updating.

## Downstream consumers

- **warren** (`../warren/src/plot-client/`) does not validate IDs against a regex — fixtures use `pl-test0001`/`pl-deadbeef` and would need updating, but no production validation logic. `runs.plot_id` is an opaque string in SQLite.
- No other published consumers known (plot is v0.1.1, fresh).

## Acceptance

1. New Plots generate `plot-<8>` IDs.
2. All regexes/schemas updated; old `pl-<8>` IDs are rejected as invalid.
3. The one in-repo Plot is migrated (rename files + edit the `id` field; consider whether to ship a one-shot migration script or just do it manually since N=1).
4. SPEC §3.3 + examples updated.
5. CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] flagging the breaking change.
6. `bun test && bun run lint && bun run typecheck` clean.

## Out of scope

- No automated migration tool — at N=1 Plot in existence, manual rename is fine.
- Warren-side test fixture updates can be filed separately against warren after plot ships.

title: Add plan_run_dispatched event type for warren PlanRun composition
description:
Add a new `plan_run_dispatched` entry to the Plot event-type enum so warren can record when a PlanRun (serial sd plan execution) is launched against a Plot. Mirrors `run_dispatched` for the per-child dispatch case — this new type covers the parent PlanRun lifecycle.

## Context

Warren-06dc (Phase 2 of the Plot adoption epic, warren-000b) threads `plot_id` through PlanRun. The seed asks for a distinct `plan_run_dispatched` event on the Plot at PlanRun start (separate from the per-child `run_dispatched` events Phase 1 already emits). Plot's `PLOT_EVENT_TYPES` is a closed enum (src/types.ts:30–42) so warren cannot land this on its own — it needs the type added in plot first, then bumps the pinned dep.

## Scope

- Add `"plan_run_dispatched"` to `PLOT_EVENT_TYPES` in src/types.ts.
- Add the discriminated event interface (e.g. `PlanRunDispatchedEvent`) to the `Event` union in src/types.ts mirroring `RunDispatchedEvent`. Payload shape: `{ plan_run_id: string, plan_id: string, children_count: number }`.
- Add the Zod schema entry in src/schemas.ts (mirror `run_dispatched` schema).
- Add the ACL entry in src/acl.ts: `plan_run_dispatched: ["user", "agent"]` (same as `run_dispatched` — orchestrators on either actor side may emit it).
- Update CLI formatter (src/cli/format.ts) and doctor (src/cli/commands/doctor.ts) replay switch to handle the new type (likely a no-op for replay, a one-line summary in format).
- Update tests: types.test.ts, schemas.test.ts, acl.test.ts, store.test.ts (if it enumerates EVENT_TYPES), views.test.ts (if it filters by type).
- Bump CHANGELOG.md + plot version (minor — additive enum entry, no breaking change).

## Acceptance

- `PLOT_EVENT_TYPES` includes `"plan_run_dispatched"`.
- `EVENT_ACL.plan_run_dispatched === ["user", "agent"]`.
- A new published version on npm warren can pin.
- Plot's full test suite + lint + typecheck stay green.
- Schema migration: none — additive enum entries don't require a schema_version bump per SPEC §7 (migrate-on-read tolerates unknown types in older readers); confirm this is the case before shipping or bump schema_version if it isn't.

## References

- warren-06dc — consumer seed; warren bumps the pinned \`@os-eco/plot-cli\` version after this lands.
- warren-000b — parent epic (Plot adoption).
- SPEC §6 — write-ACL table (this seed adds one row).

title: Add 'plot rename' command to update Plot name after creation
description:
Currently the `name` field is only settable at `plot init <name>`. There is no way to rename a Plot after creation — `plot edit` and `plot intent` only touch the intent fields, and the name persists as whatever was given at init (e.g. 'Untitled brainstorm').

## Use case
A Plot often starts as a quick scratch/brainstorm with a placeholder name, then accrues intent + attachments that clarify what it's really about. Users should be able to rename it to reflect the contents without recreating the Plot and losing the event log.

## Proposed shape
```
plot rename <id> <new-name>
```

Appends a `plot_renamed` event (`data: { from, to }`) and updates the `name` field in the JSON source. Same actor/locking semantics as `plot intent`. Reflected in `plot show` / `plot list` immediately via the existing index rebuild path.

## Acceptance
- New `plot rename` subcommand registered in the router and listed in top-level help
- Appends a `plot_renamed` event to the event log
- Updates `name` in the source JSON atomically (file lock)
- `plot show <id>` reflects the new name
- Event replay in `plot doctor` accepts `plot_renamed`
- Tests for happy path + missing id + identical name (no-op)

- `plot/scripts/check-debt-markers.ts` (port from toolkit)
- `plot/scripts/check-debt-markers.test.ts` (port + adapt)
- `plot/budgets/file-size-budgets.json` — BASELINE from plot's current state per playbook §"Baselining Ratchet Budgets"
- `plot/budgets/debt-markers-budget.json` — CRITICAL: tracker patterns MUST be plot-specific: `\\b(?:pl|mx)-[0-9a-f]+\\b`, `#\\d+\\b`, `https?://\\S+` (NOT canopy's patterns). Set `allowlist` to whatever plot currently has and ratchet down from there.

2. Take the largest current file size and write `budgets/file-size-budgets.json` with `threshold` modestly larger (round up to nearest 50, then +50). Grandfather any individual files larger than the threshold by listing them in `budgets` with their current line count.

5. Never baseline tighter than observed; ratchet only loosens with explicit human consent.

```bash
bun install
bun run scripts/check-file-sizes.ts
bun run scripts/check-debt-markers.ts
bun run check:size
```
